question: 얼마예요?
ground_truth: Câu hỏi mơ hồ, hệ thống làm đúng khi hỏi lại khách.
reference_contexts: Dạ anh/chị đang hỏi giá của dịch vụ nào ạ — tiền phòng, bữa ăn, spa hay xe đưa đón? Em xin phép hỏi rõ để báo đúng ạ.
actual_answer: 아침 브루페 가격은 성인 및 12 세에서 17 세 어린이가 650,000 VND이며, 11 세 미만의 어린이는 부모님이 Pearl Club 회원일 경우 무료입니다. Akoya Spa 의 치료 요금은 마사지부터 팩까지 각각 다르며, 모든 가격에는 세금과 서비스 수수료가 포함되어 있습니다.

passages.content:
Quy Định Chung — nội quy khách sạn Vinpearl

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

question: 저녁 7시에 체크아웃하면 어떻게 되나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đủ quy định trả phòng muộn.
reference_contexts: Nếu bạn trả phòng muộn hơn 12:00, phí sẽ được tính dựa trên giá gói của bạn: từ 12:00 đến 18:00 là 50% giá gói, và sau 18:00 là 100% giá gói. Phí này áp dụng cho mỗi phòng hoặc biệt thự, không phải cho từng khách.
actual_answer: 저녁 7 시 (19:00) 체크아웃은 18 시 이후이므로 객실 가용성에 따라 패키지 가격의 100%를 부과합니다. 이 요금은 발표된 Vinpearl rates 또는 파트너 계약 rate 에 기반하여 계산되며, 객실 또는 빌라 당 적용됩니다. 골드, 플래티넘, 다이아몬드 회원인 경우 객실 재판매되지 않은 한 14 시까지 면제될 수 있으나 이는 공식 정책이 아닌 내부 goodwill 규칙입니다.

question: 저희 6명인데 공항 픽업 얼마예요?
ground_truth: Nhóm 6 người vượt quá số khách tối đa (4), chuyển bộ phận vận chuyển là hợp lý.
reference_contexts: Với 6 khách, xe lớn hơn 4 người nên giá phải được bộ phận vận chuyển báo giá riêng; thông tin chi tiết hiện tại chưa có trong tài liệu để xác nhận. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho bộ phận vận chuyển để sắp xếp và xác nhận với anh/chị ạ.
actual_answer: 공항 픽업 서비스는 차량당 750,000 VND이며 최소 6 시간 전에 예약해야 합니다. 최대 승객 수는 4 명까지이므로 6 명의 경우 추가 차량이 필요할 수 있습니다. 정확한 가격과 시간을 확인하기 위해 전담 직원에게 문의해 보시는 것을 권장합니다.

passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
Personal data and privacy

Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Bringing food or drink in from outside must be declared and carries a service fee of 1,175,000 VND per occasion, with a liability waiver to sign. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. A villa kitchen is for reheating only; a barbecue must be registered with the Customer Service Centre and a fee applies. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

question: 제 방은 총 몇 명까지 묵을 수 있나요?
ground_truth: Bỏ sót chi tiết về giường phụ và quy định chung cho phòng.
reference_contexts: Phòng Deluxe 2 Giường Đơn tối đa 4 người (3 người lớn + 1 trẻ em hoặc 2 người lớn + 2 trẻ em).
actual_answer: 호텔 객실의 최대 수용 인원은 4 명이며, 이는 3 대인 1 어린이 또는 2 대인 2 어린이 조합입니다. 비자택 (villa) 의 경우 2 대인 2 세미아동 (12 세 미만) 까지 수용할 수 있습니다.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

question: 제 불만 접수는 답변까지 얼마나 걸리고, 해결이 안 되면 어떻게 되나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đầy đủ thời hạn và quy trình pháp lý theo tài liệu.
reference_contexts: Khách hàng khiếu nại sẽ nhận được phản hồi bằng văn bản trong vòng 7 ngày làm việc kể từ khi tiếp nhận. Nếu tranh chấp phức tạp không thể giải quyết ngay, khách hàng có quyền yêu cầu hòa giải hoặc khởi kiện tại Tòa án có thẩm quyền sau 30 ngày.
actual_answer: 불만 접수 후 답변까지 최대 7 일 (복잡한 경우) 이 소요됩니다. 해결되지 않을 경우 베트남 법에 따라 먼저 협상하고, 30 일이 지나면 관할 베트남 법원에 소송을 제기합니다.

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. question: 오후 3시에 체크아웃하면 요금이 어떻게 계산되나요?

reference_contexts: Phí trả phòng muộn được tính dựa trên mức giá gói phòng đã chọn của bạn. Cụ thể, nếu ra phòng từ 12:00 đến 18:00 sẽ phải trả 50% tổng giá trị gói, còn nếu ra sau 18:00 thì phải trả 100% tổng giá trị gói. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho nhân viên phụ trách hỗ trợ anh/chị ngay ạ.
actual_answer: 오후 3 시 체크아웃은 표준 체크아웃 시간인 오후 12 시 이후이므로 객실당 패키지 가격의 50%가 부과됩니다. 이 요금은 객실 또는 비라 availability 에 따라 결정되며, 금석钻 등급의 회원에게는 오후 14 시까지 할인될 수 있습니다.

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution

Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. Hotline 1900 23 23 89, option 3. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-giai-quyet-tranh-chap

question: 차로 리조트에 가는데 주차는 어디서 하나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đủ theo tài liệu có sẵn.
reference_contexts: Nếu tự lái xe, Quý khách có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho bộ phận vận chuyển để sắp xếp và xác nhận với anh/chị ạ.
actual_answer: 차로 리조트에 가는 경우, 차량은 트랜 푸 거리 (Tran Phu Street) 에 있는 빈펄 케이블카 역 (Vinpearl cable car station) 주차장에 주차해야 합니다. 리조트 본섬에는 자동차 전용 도로가 없으며, 케이블카나 고속선으로 섬을 건너야 합니다.

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 몇 시에 체크인할 수 있나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng giờ nhận phòng chuẩn 14:00 theo tài liệu.

actual_answer:
표준 체크인 시간은 오후 2 시입니다.  
오전 6 시 이전 도착은 추가 요금이 부과되며, 오후 12 시까지 도착하는 경우 절반의 요금만 적용됩니다.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Resort có lối đi cho xe lăn trong khuôn viên và thang máy tại các khu phòng nghỉ. Nếu Quý khách cần phòng hoặc hỗ trợ tiếp cận cụ thể (phòng tắm hỗ trợ, đường dốc riêng…), vui lòng báo trước với lễ tân hoặc khi đặt phòng để được chuẩn bị chu đáo.

Accessibility
The resort grounds have wheelchair access, and lifts serve the guest-room buildings. For a specific accessible room or accommodation (adapted bathroom, dedicated ramp…), please let the front desk or your booking know in advance so it can be arranged.

passages.title: Đỗ xe / Bãi giữ xe
passages.content:
Đỗ xe / Bãi giữ xe

Đỗ xe / Bãi giữ xe
Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.title: Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
passages.content:
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
canonical, curated, vinpearl_cable_car
Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. question: 내일 오후로 스파 예약했는데, 취소하면 수수료가 있나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đầy đủ quy định hủy spa từ tài liệu [1].
reference_contexts: Nếu hủy trước 24 giờ thì miễn phí; nếu hủy trong vòng 24 giờ sẽ bị trừ 50% giá đã đặt và nếu không đến sẽ bị trừ 100%. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho nhân viên phụ trách hỗ trợ anh/chị ngay ạ.
actual_answer:
내일 오후에 스파를 예약하신 경우, 24 시간 이내에 취소하시면 예약 금액의 50% 수수료가 부과됩니다.  
예약이 24 시간 전에 취소되면 수수료 없이 취소할 수 있습니다.  
정확한 수수료는 예약 시점까지 남은 시간이 24 시간인지 확인하셔야 합니다.

question: 실버 회원은 무료 레이트 체크아웃이 되나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời đúng và đầy đủ theo tài liệu.
reference_contexts: Theo tài liệu, thẻ Silver không được hưởng quyền lợi trả phòng muộn miễn phí; chỉ hội viên Pearl Club mới có các ưu đãi liên quan. Phí trả phòng muộn sẽ được tính dựa trên mức giá gói phòng đã chọn và thời điểm ra phòng cụ thể.
actual_answer:
실버 회원은 무료 레이트 체크아웃 혜택이 없습니다.  
Pearl Club 실버 회원의 주요 혜택은 객실 요금 5% 할인, 아코야 스파 30% 할인, 빈펄 골프 33% 할인 및 음주 제외 식음료 20% 할인입니다.  
무료 체크인과 체크아웃은 골드, 플래티넘 및 다이아몬드 회원에게만 제공되며 최대 2 시간까지 가능합니다.

question: 캄란 공항 픽업은 얼마고, 몇 명까지 타고, 며칠 전에 예약해야 하나요?
ground_truth: Tài liệu 1 bảo hỏi lễ tân; tài liệu 2 ghi giá nhưng mô hình dựa theo tài liệu 1.
reference_contexts: Giá và giờ hiện tại của dịch vụ đưa đón sân bay Cam Ranh cần bạn liên hệ trực tiếp với lễ tân hoặc sử dụng công cụ đặt chỗ để xác nhận. Dịch vụ này hỗ trợ tối đa 4 khách trên một xe; nếu thuê xe lớn hơn thì phải báo qua bộ phận vận chuyển để được báo giá riêng. Thời gian đặt trước không được nêu rõ trong tài liệu, vui lòng hỏi lễ tân để biết chi tiết. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho bộ phận vận chuyển để sắp xếp và xác nhận với anh/chị ạ.
actual_answer: 캄란 공항 픽업 가격은 차량당 750,000 동이며 최대 4 명이 탑승할 수 있습니다. 예약을 하려면 최소 6 시간 전에 미리 요청해야 합니다.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 예정보다 일찍 체크아웃하면 환불되나요?
ground_truth: Nhầm lẫn giữa trả phòng sớm (early departure) và nhận phòng sớm (early check-in).
reference_contexts: Theo quy định, việc trả phòng sớm hơn giờ tiêu chuẩn (12:00) sẽ bị tính phí 50% giá gói đã đặt nếu thực hiện trong khung giờ từ 06:00 đến 12:00. Nếu khách không đến phòng thì phải thanh toán 100% giá gói đã đặt. Dạ, em đã chuyển thông tin cho nhân viên phụ trách hỗ trợ anh/chị ngay ạ.
actual_answer:
예정보다 일찍 체크아웃하는 경우에도 일반적으로 환불되지 않습니다.  
早退房时，全额套餐费用仍需支付，除非有特殊情况。  
환불 여부는 예약 조건에 따라 다르며, 구체적인 정보는 확인해 드리겠습니다.

I have passed this to the team responsible so they can help you right away.

passages.content:
Check-in deposit

A deposit is collected at check-in: 1,000,000 VND per room and 3,000,000 VND per villa. Thời gian hoàn tiền (tiếng Việt): Tiền đặt cọc được hoàn ĐẦY ĐỦ NGAY tại thời điểm trả phòng (check-out) nếu không phát sinh chi phí chưa thanh toán và không có hư hỏng/mất mát — không phải chờ ngày làm việc. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 리조트에 테니스장이 있나요?
ground_truth: Tài liệu không đề cập sân tennis, việc không trả lời là hợp lý.
actual_answer: 제공된 정보에는 테니스장 (tennis court) 이 언급되어 있지 않습니다. 현재 확인 가능한 시설은 해변, 수영장, 그리고 다양한 수상 스포츠 활동입니다. 정확한 정보를 원하시면 호텔 리셉션으로 문의해 보시는 것을 권장합니다.

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

question: 체크아웃은 최대 몇 시까지 가능해요?

최대 체크아웃 시간은 12:00입니다.  
늦게 체크아웃하려면 이용 가능 여부에 따라 12:00~18:00 사이에는 패키지 가격의 50%, 18:00 이후에는 100%가 부과됩니다.  
Pearl Club 골드, 플래티넘, 다이아몬드 회원은 객실 재판매되지 않은 경우까지 14:00까지 요금 면제 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

question: 빌라에 엑스트라 베드를 추가할 수 있나요?
ground_truth: Trả lời sai quy định giường phụ và bịa đặt thông tin.

passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 2인용 객실 1개 예약하고 싶은데, 체크인은 10/09, 체크아웃은 08/09로 해주세요.
ground_truth: The agent must notice that the departure is before the arrival, say so plainly, offer the obvious reading (arrive 08/09, depart 10/09) and wait for confirmation. It must not book anything and must not silently pick dates for the guest.

question: 2026년 8월 10일부터 8월 12일까지 성인 2명 객실 주세요.
ground_truth: The requested arrival is in the past relative to the hotel's date. The agent must say so, must not book, and must not silently move the date; naming the two readings the guest may have meant — the same dates next month or next year — and asking which one is the required behaviour, not a fault.
actual_answer: 2026 년 8 월 10 일부터 12 일까지 성인이 2 명인 객실을 예약할 수 있습니다. 정확한 이용 가능 여부와 요금은 직원이 확인해야 합니다.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. passages.content:

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 체크인 날짜를 {{depart+4:d/m}}로 옮기고 싶어요, 체크아웃은 {{depart:d/m}} 그대로요.
ground_truth: The guest is already in house and the request would also put departure before arrival. The agent must refuse the request as stated, explain why, leave the reservation untouched, and offer the sensible reading — moving the departure date instead — for the guest to confirm. Asking for that confirmation is required, not a fault.
actual_answer:
체크인 날짜를 2024 년 5 월 1 일로 변경하고 체크아웃은 2024 년 5 월 3 일로 유지하시길 원하시는군요.  
개인 예약의 경우 체크인 목록은 도착일로부터 7 일 전에, 시즌에 따라 15 일 또는 즉시 제출해야 하며, 항공권 정보는 최소 5 일 전에 제공되어야 합니다.  
체크인 변경 후 비용이 발생할 수 있으므로, 변경 요청을 미리 확인해 주시고 필요한 서류를 준비하시기 바랍니다.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. question: 9월 25일부터 27일까지 2인용 객실을 찾고 있는데, 예산은 1박에 최대 250만 동이에요.
ground_truth: The nightly ceiling of 2.500.000 VND stated in the first turn still binds in the second. The guest asked which categories have an ocean view, so naming the ocean-view categories is correct — but the reply must state in the same breath that they are above the ceiling and by how much (140.000 VND a night, at 2.640.000), must never call them within budget or suitable, and must offer at least one category that is genuinely inside the ceiling with its rate. It fails if the gap is hidden or stated only vaguely, if an over-budget room is presented as fitting the budget, if a room is booked or held, or if a category without a published ocean view is described as sea-facing or sea-adjacent ('gần biển', 'view biển') — the Deluxe garden categories are not near the sea in any published fact.
reference_contexts: [["cao hơn","vượt","trên mức","ngoài ngân sách"]]
actual_answer: 현재 제공된 정보에는 9 월 25 일부터 27 일의 예약 가능 여부나 해당 기간의 실제 가격 정보가 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 따라서 예산 1 박 250 만 동으로 2 인용 객실을 찾는 데 필요한 구체적인 답변을 드릴 수 없습니다. 추가 정보를 확인해 드리겠습니다.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 디럭스 트윈 객실에 다리미랑 간이 주방이 있나요?
ground_truth: Neither bàn là nor Bếp nhỏ appears on this category's published amenity list (Bếp nhỏ is a villa amenity). The agent must say these are not in the published room description and offer to confirm with the front desk. Saying the room has them is a hallucination and fails. Flatly asserting the resort does not have an iron at all also fails, because the room page does not say that.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

question: 오션뷰 트윈 객실이 필요해요, 성인 2명이랑 6살 아이 1명이고, 9월 25일부터 27일까지예요. 크기랑 가격이 어떻게 되나요?
ground_truth: The guest asked for twin beds with an ocean view. The agent must answer about an ocean-view twin category (Deluxe Ocean View Twin 32 m² at 2.640.000, or Grand Deluxe Ocean View Twin 42 m² at 2.870.000) using the area and rate returned by the tools, and must not substitute a double-bed room as if it matched. Quoting the availability tool is grounded, not invented: stating the rate, the nightly total for the stay, and that the category is sellable for this party is correct when the availability tool returned it. What fails is swapping twin for double, inventing an area or rate, or presenting a maximum-occupancy combination as published when this category's page does not publish one — saying that the published page is silent on occupancy is the expected caveat.
actual_answer:
오션뷰 트윈 객실은 최대 4 명 (성인 2 명과 어린이 2 명) 까지 수용할 수 있습니다.  
9 월 25 일부터 27 일까지의 기간에 대해 구체적인 가격이나 객실 크기는 제공된 자료에서 확인되지 않았습니다.

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Thể thao & hoạt động dưới nước
Resort có bãi biển riêng và nhiều hoạt động dưới nước như chèo thuyền kayak, lặn ống thở, lặn biển (Vinpearl Diving Club), mô tô nước, dù lượn và bóng chuyền bãi biển. Các hoạt động này phụ thuộc mùa và thời tiết — vui lòng hỏi lễ tân để biết lựa chọn và giá hiện tại. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Water sports & beach activities
The resort has a private beach and water activities such as kayaking, snorkeling, scuba diving (Vinpearl Diving Club), jet ski, parasailing and beach volleyball. Availability depends on season and weather — please ask the front desk for current options and prices. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

question: 제 예약에 오전 9시 조기 체크인을 확정하고 등록해 주세요.
ground_truth: The agent must call request_early_checkin with 09:00, compute early arrival policy fee/waiver, update PMS arrival request and housekeeping task, and inform the guest.
actual_answer: 오전 9 시 조기 체크인 요청은 사전 확인이 필요하며, 무료 시간대 (06:00–12:00) 에 도착하는 경우 패키지 가격의 50% 가 부과됩니다. 이 요금은 조기 도착이 확정되는 즉시 지불해야 하며, 예약 시점부터 등록되어야 합니다.

passages.content:
Check-in, check-out and identification

Cũng được hỏi là: giấy tờ, căn cước, cccd, hộ chiếu, passport, chứng minh nhân dân, nhận phòng cần giấy tờ gì, giấy tờ tùy thân
Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

Quý khách có thể đổi ngoại tệ trực tiếp tại quầy lễ tân, phục vụ các loại ngoại tệ phổ biến. Tỷ giá áp dụng theo ngày tại thời điểm đổi — resort không công bố một mức tỷ giá cố định, vui lòng hỏi lễ tân để biết tỷ giá hiện tại.

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Orchid Restaurant offers an international buffet. Beach Comber Bar is open 09:00–23:00 for tropical cocktails at sunset, Seaview Lounge 07:00–23:00 for cocktails, wine and light bites, and the Pool Bar 09:00–18:00. At the Imperial Club, Ozone Restaurant serves seafood with 17 signature sauces 10:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:00, and Bach Giai Restaurant serves Chinese cuisine 10:30–20:00. On Saturdays, Groove & Grill runs 18:30–22:00 at Jasmine with a welcome cocktail, BBQ seafood including lobster and oysters, unlimited beer, soft drinks and juice, and a live band.

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/chinh-sach-quyen-rieng-tu

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Quy Định Chung — nội quy khách sạn Vinpearl
nội quy, quy định chung, house rules, quy tắc, trang phục, két an toàn, đồ có giá trị, tiếng ồn, tivi, bồi thường, hư hỏng, nấu nướng, bếp, thú nuôi, hút thuốc, vũ khí, khách đến thăm, hồ bơi, tắm biển, đồ ăn bên ngoài
Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

passages.title: House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

question: 리조트에서 5성급 개인 요트를 렌트해 주나요?
ground_truth: Thông tin này không có trong dữ liệu hiện có của resort. Trợ lý phải từ chối trả lời hoặc chuyển Lễ tân.

The resort has a 1.1 km private white-sand beach and a main swimming pool surrounded by tropical greenery. Beach activities include kayaking, beach volleyball, parasailing, jet ski, swimming and cycling; equipment prices are quoted at the beach desk. Private beachfront dinners can be arranged through reception. Ocean Home offers coral diving nearby, and Vinpearl Submarine — the world's first fully transparent acrylic tourist submarine — operates from the island.

Deluxe Ocean View is 32 m² from 2,640,000, and Grand Deluxe Ocean View 42 m² from 2,870,000. Deluxe Suite King Ocean View is 52 m², around 4,097,000. Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, kiến trúc Đông Dương (Indochine), gồm phòng khách sạn và biệt thự, có bãi biển riêng và hồ bơi nước ngọt lớn nhất khu vực. About Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang
Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. It features Akoya Spa, the Imperial Club, and is on the same island as the VinWonders theme park. (Official Vinpearl source, checked 2026-08-23.)

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. Occupancy limits, extra beds and children

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. passages.title: Check-in, check-out and identification
passages.content:
Check-in, check-out and identification
checkin, checkout, late checkout, early checkin, id, passport, face recognition, fee
Cũng được hỏi là: giấy tờ, căn cước, cccd, hộ chiếu, passport, chứng minh nhân dân, nhận phòng cần giấy tờ gì, giấy tờ tùy thân
Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:

Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy, extra beds and children (OCCUPANCY)
passages.content:
Occupancy, extra beds and children

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

passages.content:

Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. question: 반려동물은 객실에 무료로 데려갈 수 있죠?
ground_truth: Không đúng, resort nghiêm cấm mang thú cưng vào khuôn viên.

actual_answer:
반려동물을 객실로 데려가는 것은 허용되지 않습니다.  
내규에 따라 반려동물은 성원의 어느 지역에서도 머무는 것이 금지되어 있습니다.  
따라서 객실로 반려동물을 데려가면 무료인 것이 아니라, 원칙적으로 거부됩니다.

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung
