question: 조식 뷔페는 18세 미만 모든 어린이가 무료죠?
ground_truth: Không đúng, chỉ miễn phí ăn sáng cho trẻ em theo gói hoặc dưới 4 tuổi.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, chỉ miễn phí ăn sáng cho trẻ em theo gói hoặc dưới 4 tuổi.
actual_answer: 조식 뷔페 가격은 성인 및 12 세에서 17 세 사이의 어린이가 650,000 VND이고 11 세 이하의 어린이는 375,000 VND 입니다. Pearl Club 회원이 있을 경우 12 세 미만의 두 명의 어린이에게만 조식이 무료이며, 다른 모든 어린이는 유료입니다.

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Pets are not allowed anywhere on the property. Smoking is only permitted in the signed smoking areas; smoking elsewhere costs 3,000,000 VND per stay. Durian, jackfruit and other strongly scented food may not be taken into the rooms, and weapons, chemicals and explosives are prohibited. passages.content:
Quy Định Chung — nội quy khách sạn Vinpearl
nội quy, quy định chung, house rules, quy tắc, trang phục, két an toàn, đồ có giá trị, tiếng ồn, tivi, bồi thường, hư hỏng, nấu nướng, bếp, thú nuôi, hút thuốc, vũ khí, khách đến thăm, hồ bơi, tắm biển, đồ ăn bên ngoài
Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Vinpearl Resort Nha Trang sits on Hon Tre Island in Indochine-style architecture, with hotel rooms and villas, a private beach, and the largest freshwater swimming pool in the region. passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. question: 제가 가져온 생해산물을 주방에서 무료로 요리해 줄 수 있나요?
ground_truth: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
reference_contexts: Không đúng, nhà hàng không nhận chế biến đồ ăn mang ngoài vào và có tính phí dịch vụ.
actual_answer: 생선이나 해산물 등 외부 음식을 조리할 수 있는 시설은 없습니다. 별 thự/칸호의 주방은 음식만 hâm nóng (가열) 하는 용도로만 사용되며, 모든 형태의 조리나 요리 준비는 엄격히 금지되어 있습니다. 외부 음식을 가져오거나 조리하려면 추가 서비스 비용이 발생하며, 이는 무료 조리가 아닙니다.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Early check-in must be confirmed in advance and is never granted before 12:00 without a charge: arrival before 06:00 is charged 100% of the package price and arrival between 06:00 and 12:00 is charged 50%, payable as soon as the early arrival is confirmed. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
passages.content:
Occupancy limits, extra beds and children
occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

passages.content:

Cáp treo Vinpearl ra đảo Hòn Tre
Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. Thời gian khoảng 8 phút; hoạt động 08:30–23:00, từ 23:00–02:00 di chuyển bằng tàu cao tốc. Đây là tuyến cáp treo vượt biển dài nhất thế giới (kỷ lục Guinness), dài 2.643 m. Giờ chạy có thể thay đổi — nên xác nhận lại với lễ tân trước khi đi. (Nguồn chính thức Vinpearl/VinWonders, cập nhật 23/08/2026.)

Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

Cam Ranh International Airport to Cau Da Port takes 45–60 minutes by car. From Cau Da / Vinpearl Harbour you cross to Hon Tre Island either by cable car or by speedboat. The cable car is 2,642.8 m long, takes about 8 minutes, carries 8 guests per cabin and runs from about 08:30 to 23:00 (times can change — confirm with reception); the last speedboat back to the mainland leaves around 23:15. A complimentary (free of charge) electric buggy runs between the pier, the cable-car station and the resort buildings — call reception. Vinpearl and VinWonders guests also have a free round-trip VinBus. Source: https://vinpearl.com/vi/lich-trinh-di-vinpearl-harbour-nha-trang

Resort nằm trên đảo Hòn Tre, không có đường cho ô tô riêng lên đảo — Quý khách di chuyển bằng cáp treo hoặc tàu cao tốc. Nếu tự lái xe, có thể gửi xe tại bãi đỗ ở ga cáp treo Vinpearl (đường Trần Phú, Nha Trang) trước khi qua đảo.

Parking
The resort is on Hon Tre Island with no road access for private cars — guests cross by cable car or speedboat. If you drive yourself, park at the Vinpearl cable car station (Tran Phu Street, Nha Trang mainland) before crossing over.

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

Cáp treo Vinpearl nối đất liền với đảo Hòn Tre (nơi có resort và VinWonders). Ga cáp treo ở đường Trần Phú, phường Nam Nha Trang, Khánh Hòa. The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Quy Định Chung của khách sạn Vinpearl / VinOasis (nội quy khách sạn). Khách vui lòng hiểu rõ và tuân theo:

1. Tuân thủ quy định của Nhà nước và Khách sạn về an toàn phòng, chống dịch bệnh.
2. Tất cả khách lưu trú phải mang theo giấy tờ tùy thân hợp lệ theo Luật lưu trú.
3. Thú nuôi KHÔNG được phép mang vào khu vực Khách sạn.
4. Hút thuốc (bao gồm cả thuốc lá điện tử) chỉ được phép tại nơi có biển cho phép và/hoặc ngoài ban công phòng. Vi phạm: phí phục hồi/làm sạch/khử mùi là 3.000.000 VNĐ cho một lần ở có phát hiện.
5. Tuân thủ quy định an toàn khi di chuyển bằng xe trong khu vực Khách sạn.
6. Cư xử đúng mực nơi công cộng: đến trước phục vụ trước; ưu tiên phụ nữ mang thai, người khuyết tật, người già yếu; không gây ồn ào, la hét; không gác chân lên ghế; quản lý trẻ em ở khu vực công cộng.
7. Cất giữ vật dụng có giá trị trong két an toàn tại phòng hoặc gửi quầy Lễ tân.

A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. passages.title: Personal data and privacy
passages.content:
Personal data and privacy
privacy, personal data, gdpr, consent, children, rights, delete, card, cvv
Vinpearl distinguishes basic personal data from sensitive personal data and processes it to deliver and support the service, to improve it, for marketing and to meet legal obligations. Data is stored in Vietnam and is never sold; it may be shared with Vingroup companies, service partners and the authorities where the law requires. Card numbers and CVV codes are not stored. A child's data needs a parent's consent, and from the age of 7 the child's own consent as well. Guests hold eleven rights over their data, including the right to be informed, to consent, to access, to withdraw consent, to delete, to restrict processing, to be given a copy, to object, to complain, to compensation and to protect themselves. passages.title: Complaints and dispute resolution
passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. Vinpearl cable car to Hon Tre Island
The Vinpearl cable car links the mainland to Hon Tre Island (home to the resort and VinWonders). The mainland station is on Tran Phu Street, Nam Nha Trang Ward, Khanh Hoa. The ride takes about 8 minutes and runs 08:30–23:00; from 23:00–02:00 transfer is by high-speed boat. It holds the Guinness record for the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, at 2,643 m.

For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. passages.content:
House rules — visitors, pool, sea and noise
visitors, guest curfew, pool, swimming, sea, noise, quiet hours, safe, valuables, eviction
A visitor leaves an identity document at reception, and no visitors are allowed in the rooms after 20:00; anyone staying overnight must be registered and paid for. The swimming pool closes at 22:00 at the latest, and swimming in the sea is not allowed after 19:00 because there is no lifeguard on duty. After 22:00 keep the television at volume 10 or below and do not use loudspeakers. Valuables belong in the in-room safe or with reception — the hotel is not liable for items left elsewhere. Guests who repeatedly break the rules can be asked to leave with no refund. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-chung

passages.content:
Complaints and dispute resolution
complaint, dispute, escalation, 7 days, hotline, legal, court, contact
Complaints go through three steps. Customer service or sales receive the complaint and answer immediately using the published policy. A complex case that cannot be answered on the spot gets a reply within 7 days at the latest. The outcome is then passed to the departments concerned and confirmed with the guest by telephone. Disputes are governed by Vietnamese law: the parties negotiate first, and if there is no agreement within 30 days the case goes to the competent Vietnamese court. The company is Cong ty Co phan Vinpearl, Hon Tre Island, Vinh Nguyen Ward, Nha Trang, Khanh Hoa, with a Hanoi office in the Symphony Tower, Chu Huy Man Street, Vinhomes Riverside, Long Bien. For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

passages.title: Guest list deadlines and name changes
passages.content:
Guest list deadlines and name changes
guest list, name change, deadline, transfer, flight, shuttle, meal, full board, fee
For individual bookings the guest list must be sent 7 days before arrival in low season, 15 days in high season, and at the moment of booking in peak season and during Tet. Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Check-in follows the standard time and check-out must be no later than 12:00. Guests present an ID card or passport at check-in; children travelling with the family need a birth certificate, and a photograph is taken for the face-recognition check-in with the guest's consent. Late departure is subject to availability and is charged 50% of the package price between 12:00 and 18:00 and 100% after 18:00. Charges are calculated on Vinpearl's published rate (Gia Cong Bo), or on the contract rate when a partner settles the bill. passages.content:

occupancy, extra bed, children, child, family, villa, surcharge, height, age, max guests
A hotel room takes a maximum of 4 people including children under 4 — either 3 adults and 1 child, or 2 adults and 2 children. At most one extra bed can be added per room and availability depends on the individual hotel. Children aged 4 to under 12 and everyone aged 12 and over are charged a surcharge. In a villa the limit is 2 adults plus 2 children under 12 per bedroom, and extra beds are not available in villas other than Vinpearl Luxury Nha Trang. The package price assumes 2 adults per room, or 2 adults per villa bedroom. When there is no birth certificate to prove age, height decides: under 1 m counts as under 4, 1 m to 1.4 m counts as 4 to under 12, and above 1.4 m counts as 12 and over. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong

Package codes: RO room only, BB bed and breakfast, HB half board, FB full board, and the villa and BBQ variants ROV, BBV, BBVS, BBW, FBV, FBVS, FBW, FBSFD, FVSFD, FXSFD, FWSFD, FBBQD, FVBQD, FXBQD, FWBQD, plus G1P and G2P for 18 holes of golf for one or two players. An individual booking (Khach Le) is up to 9 rooms or 4 villas per night; from 10 rooms or 5 villas it is a group booking, and three or more groups on the same itinerary form a series. The full package price is payable for the whole registered stay even if the guest leaves early. A voucher must be presented and surrendered at check-in, otherwise the published rate is charged. In exceptional cases such as force majeure or renovation Vinpearl may move guests to an equivalent room or hotel. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/dieu-khoan-chung

Flight details for an airport transfer are needed at least 5 days ahead, and a transfer can only be changed or cancelled at least 72 hours before the pick-up. Changing a guest's identity after the deadline costs 350,000 VND per room per change; the fee is waived on proof of illness or a natural disaster. A request to change a full-board meal must reach the hotel at least 5 days ahead and is only possible for check-in before 13:00. On the free shuttle, be in the lobby 15 minutes before departure — the bus leaves on time without waiting. Source: https://booking.vinpearl.com/vi-VND/dieu-khoan/quy-dinh-ve-xac-nhan-dat-phong
